ui.温度：蓝色冷、红色热，固定 -20～60℃。污染：绿色清洁、红色高负荷；每格取所:
Temperature: blue is cold and red is hot, on a fixed -20 to 60°C scale. Pollution: green is clean and red is heavily polluted; each cell shows the highest normalized load among registered pollution types, including MODs. Unloaded areas are transparent.
Monster navigation: each reachable cell shows the next step toward the local player. A blue dot marks the player's target cell; a red cross marks unreachable cells. Obstacles and unloaded cells are not drawn. This reads the actual shared flow field; it does not mean every monster is chasing. Nothing appears until the target is ready.
Higher opacity makes the surface clearer: 0% fully covered, 100% fully transparent.

itemDescriptions.AtmosphereAnalyzer: Use while held to open the instrument screen and measure the current planet's atmospheric composition, total gas quantity and pressure in real time. Total gas is shown in standard cubic meters.
itemDescriptions.Bear: Normally peaceful. A player remaining within 8 metres for more than 60 continuous seconds provokes the bear with 120 hatred. Hatred decays by 1 per second, and each confirmed hit adds 30 hatred toward its attacker.
itemDescriptions.LiquidTankBlock_Iron: Adjacent matching blocks combine into one shared liquid tank, adding 100 L per block. Different liquids cannot combine. All four sides connect to liquid pipes. Dismantling takes the removed block capacity share of the contents.
itemDescriptions.LiquidTankBlock_Iron_Summoner: Adjacent matching blocks combine into one shared liquid tank, adding 100 L per block. Different liquids cannot combine. All four sides connect to liquid pipes. Dismantling takes the removed block capacity share of the contents.
itemDescriptions.LiquidTankBlock_Steel: Adjacent matching blocks combine into one shared liquid tank, adding 100 L per block. Different liquids cannot combine. All four sides connect to liquid pipes. Dismantling takes the removed block capacity share of the contents.
itemDescriptions.LiquidTankBlock_Steel_Summoner: Adjacent matching blocks combine into one shared liquid tank, adding 100 L per block. Different liquids cannot combine. All four sides connect to liquid pipes. Dismantling takes the removed block capacity share of the contents.
itemDescriptions.PortableGasTank_Steel_Building: Stores 60 standard L of gas. Filling equipment can fill it completely. Natural refill stops at 20% and never vents existing contents. Placement and dismantling preserve its contents.
itemDescriptions.PortableGasTank_Iron_Building: Stores 20 standard L of gas. Filling equipment can fill it completely. Natural refill stops at 20% and never vents existing contents. Placement and dismantling preserve its contents.
itemDescriptions.LiquidFiller_Summoner: Fills three actual containers in slot order 0, 1, 2. Skips unsuitable or full slots. Maximum rate: 2 L per second.
itemDescriptions.LiquidFiller: Fills three actual containers in slot order 0, 1, 2. Skips unsuitable or full slots. Maximum rate: 2 L per second.
itemDescriptions.GasFiller_Summoner: Fills three actual containers in slot order 0, 1, 2. Skips unsuitable or full slots. Maximum rate: 2 L per second.
itemDescriptions.GasFiller: Fills three actual containers in slot order 0, 1, 2. Skips unsuitable or full slots. Maximum rate: 2 L per second.
itemDescriptions.LiquidOutlet_Summoner: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.LiquidOutlet: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.LiquidValve_Summoner: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.LiquidValve: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.LiquidPipe_Summoner: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.LiquidPipe: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.Egg: An egg laid by a hen. It can be eaten, cooked, or hatched.
itemDescriptions.Bandage_Plant: Use while held to bandage the head or torso, restoring 10 points of part durability. Does not restore health.
itemDescriptions.Battery_Basic: Stores surplus power from the grid and discharges automatically when generation is insufficient.
itemDescriptions.Battery_Basic_Summoner: Stores surplus power from the grid and discharges automatically when generation is insufficient.
itemDescriptions.Boat_Building: A white outline appears when the cursor points at the raft. On land or in water, point at the raft and press F to board or dismount. Normal rowing uses no stamina; hold Shift while moving to spend stamina and row faster. Pointing at reachable seawater still lets F interact with the water and drink. The raft drifts with currents. Dismounting far offshore puts you in the water if no land is nearby. A loaded save restores it as an empty raft.
itemDescriptions.CactusPiece: A juicy cactus chunk with its spines removed. Eat it to restore 40 water and a small amount of nutrition.
itemDescriptions.Conveyor_Wood: Moves dropped items on the ground when connected to mechanical power. Rotate the building to change direction; reversing power reverses transport. Rated for 20 RPM and 0.8 tiles per second.
itemDescriptions.Conveyor_Wood_Summoner: Moves dropped items on the ground when connected to mechanical power. Rotate the building to change direction; reversing power reverses transport. Rated for 20 RPM and 0.8 tiles per second.
itemDescriptions.ElectricLightBulb: Lights automatically when connected to a copper wire in the same cell and turns off without power. Its radius is 16 tiles, twice that of a torch.
itemDescriptions.ElectricLightBulb_Summoner: Lights automatically when connected to a copper wire in the same cell and turns off without power. Its radius is 16 tiles, twice that of a torch.
itemDescriptions.Fiber: Coarse fiber stripped from plant skins. A basic material for rope and other survival items.
itemDescriptions.FilterResidue: Solid impurities separated by filtration or electrolysis.
itemDescriptions.FluidFilter: A fluid filter. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.FluidFilter_Summoner: A fluid filter. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.GasCompressor_Electric: An electric gas compressor. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.GasCompressor_Electric_Summoner: An electric gas compressor. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.GasCompressor_Mechanical: A mechanical gas compressor. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.GasCompressor_Mechanical_Summoner: A mechanical gas compressor. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.GasPump_Mechanical: With mechanical power, takes actual mixed gas from the environment at 2 standard L per second and can fill tanks to capacity.
itemDescriptions.GasPump_Mechanical_Summoner: With mechanical power, takes actual mixed gas from the environment at 2 standard L per second and can fill tanks to capacity.
itemDescriptions.Gear_Wood: Only the short shaft on its left connects to a drive shaft. Its teeth mesh with adjacent gears.
itemDescriptions.Gear_Wood_Summoner: When placed, only the short shaft on its left connects to a drive shaft. Its teeth mesh with adjacent gears.
itemDescriptions.Gearbox_Wood: Gearbox building. Input through the large gear outputs 2× speed and 0.5× torque; input through the small gear outputs 0.5× speed and 2× torque.
itemDescriptions.Gearbox_Wood_Summoner: When placed, input through the large gear outputs 2× speed and 0.5× torque; input through the small gear outputs 0.5× speed and 2× torque.
itemDescriptions.IronBucket_Building: An open iron bucket placed on the ground. It catches rain and can be dismantled without losing its liquid, temperature, or rain collection progress.
itemDescriptions.LiquidPump_Electric: An electric liquid pump. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.LiquidPump_Electric_Summoner: An electric liquid pump. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.LiquidStorageTank: Stores 200 L of one liquid independently. Rejects other liquids. Dismantling preserves its contents.
itemDescriptions.LiquidStorageTank_Summoner: Stores 200 L of one liquid independently. Rejects other liquids. Dismantling preserves its contents.
itemDescriptions.MechanicalBellows: Point the outlet at an adjacent furnace or blast furnace to raise its maximum temperature based on speed. At 20 RPM it adds up to 300°C; only the higher bonus from the bellows or oxygen-assisted combustion applies.
itemDescriptions.MechanicalBellows_Summoner: Point the outlet at an adjacent furnace or blast furnace to raise its maximum temperature based on speed. At 20 RPM it adds up to 300°C; only the higher bonus from the bellows or oxygen-assisted combustion applies.
itemDescriptions.MechanicalHammer_Summoner: A mechanical hammer that connects to a drive shaft and automatically processes pig iron, wrought iron, copper, bronze, tin, and steel ingots.
itemDescriptions.MechanicalLoom: Connect it to mechanical power to weave materials. Cotton can be woven into cloth and silk into silk; higher speed makes processing faster.
itemDescriptions.MechanicalLoom_Summoner: Connect it to mechanical power after placing it to weave automatically. The loom provides the weaving operation; the input materials determine the output and work required.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Coal_Large: A huge natural coal deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular coal deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Copper_Large: A huge natural copper deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular copper deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Gold: A gold-bearing vein that must be mined with a pickaxe. Mining drops gold ore.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Gold_Large: A huge natural gold deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular gold deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Iron_Large: A huge natural iron deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular iron deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Niter_Large: A huge natural niter deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular niter deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Obsidian_Large: A huge natural obsidian deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular obsidian deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Stone_Large: A huge natural stone deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular stone deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Sulfur: Sulfur ore found in mountains and around mountain lava vents. Mining drops sulfur; pickaxes improve yield, with no minimum tool tier.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Sulfur_Large: A huge natural sulfur deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular sulfur deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Tin_Large: A huge natural tin deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular tin deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Tungsten_Large: A huge natural tungsten deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular tungsten deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Ore_Gold: Gold-bearing ore that can be smelted into gold ingots.
itemDescriptions.Peat: Flammable organic soil dug from wetlands. Can be used as a low-temperature fuel.
itemDescriptions.PortableGasTank_Iron: Stores 20 standard L of gas. Filling equipment can fill it completely. Natural refill stops at 20% and never vents existing contents. Placement and dismantling preserve its contents.
itemDescriptions.PortableGasTank_Steel: Stores 60 standard L of gas. Filling equipment can fill it completely. Natural refill stops at 20% and never vents existing contents. Placement and dismantling preserve its contents.
itemDescriptions.PressureProbe_Electronic: An electronic gas-pressure probe. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.PressureProbe_Electronic_Summoner: An electronic gas-pressure probe. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.PressureProbe_Mechanical: A mechanical gas-pressure probe. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.PressureProbe_Mechanical_Summoner: A mechanical gas-pressure probe. Use its configuration panel to inspect actual gas and liquid contents, direction, and power. Empty equipment starts under vacuum.
itemDescriptions.Scissors: Aim at a nearby grass layer. When a white square appears, right-click or tap to cut one tile of grass and collect 2 plant fibers. Scissors can also harvest wildflowers.
itemDescriptions.Seed_Foxtail: Foxtail seeds made by grinding foxtail grass in a stone mortar. Plant them on valid farmland; they can also be eaten directly.
itemDescriptions.ShipAirSupply: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipAirSupply_Summoner: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipConsole: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipConsole_Summoner: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipDockingPort: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipDockingPort_Summoner: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipDoor: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipDoor_Summoner: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipFiber: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipFiber_Summoner: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipGravityGenerator: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipGravityGenerator_Summoner: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipNavigation: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipNavigation_Summoner: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipWall_Iron: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipWall_Iron_Summoner: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipWall_Refractory: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipWall_Refractory_Summoner: Installed on a local cell of a ship floor. Moves, rotates, and saves with its hull.
itemDescriptions.ShipWreck: Large debris left when a hull breaks apart. It records the original components and inventory; attack it to salvage and release its contents.
itemDescriptions.Shovel_Bronze: A durable bronze shovel that digs grass, sand, peat, and riverbank clay faster.
itemDescriptions.Shovel_RawIron: A transitional shovel made from raw iron. Digs faster than a copper shovel, but the metal has not been fully refined.
itemDescriptions.SiliconPlate: A thin silicon sheet with a smooth, dark gray surface.
itemDescriptions.Snowball: A packed snowball dug up with a shovel. Right-click to place it; each snowball adds one snow layer. Stack layers, then shovel them back up.
itemDescriptions.StoneSlab: A heavy slab mined from a large stone deposit or a cave entrance.
itemDescriptions.ToolCabinet: A one-slot tool cabinet. Workbenches within eight adjacent cells can use its slot as a sixth material slot. A workbench cannot receive this bonus from more than one cabinet.
itemDescriptions.ToolCabinet_Summoner: A one-slot tool cabinet. Workbenches within eight adjacent cells can use its slot as a sixth material slot. A workbench cannot receive this bonus from more than one cabinet.
itemDescriptions.WaterTrough_Building: A placed trough that holds 64 units of mixed liquid and can connect to a liquid pump or outlet. Dismantling it preserves the liquid mix, temperature, pending output batches, and durability.
itemDescriptions.Wire_Hidden_Summoner: Copper wire with a concealing sheath. It carries power normally; hold it or wear engineering goggles to see and handle it.
itemDescriptions.WoodenBarrel_Building: A water barrel placed on the ground. Dismantle it without losing its liquid, stored items, or durability quality.
itemDescriptions.Wool: Soft wool sheared from sheep. Use it to make cloth.
itemDescriptions.Beehive: A wild beehive beside a forest tree, with a golden wax layer and a dark entrance.
itemDescriptions.BirdEgg: An egg laid by small birds and seagulls. It can be picked up, eaten, or cooked. Each bird can lay one at most every two days.
itemDescriptions.Blowgun_Wood: Hold the attack button to charge, then blow into the microphone. Releasing fires one arrow from the same inventory. Louder blows make arrows fly faster and add up to 100% damage.
itemDescriptions.Cactus: A drought-tolerant plant that grows in arid deserts, not on wet beaches or riverbanks. Touching it causes puncture damage. Mature plants yield edible, hydrating cactus chunks and can also be cleared with a weapon.
itemDescriptions.CarbonFilament: A filament made by heating thin thread to 500°C until it carbonizes. Combine it with glass, copper plate, and wrought iron ingot at a workbench to make a light bulb.
itemDescriptions.CommandManual: A chat command manual obtained with /help. It contains one piece of charcoal. Hold it and use it to read and edit the manual.
itemDescriptions.Conveyor_Cloth: A cloth belt connects the rollers and carries items; a wooden frame supports it. When powered, it moves dropped items on the ground. Rotate the building to change direction; reversing power reverses transport. Rated for 20 RPM and 0.8 tiles per second.
itemDescriptions.Conveyor_Cloth_Summoner: A cloth belt connects the rollers and carries items; a wooden frame supports it. When powered, it moves dropped items on the ground. Rotate the building to change direction; reversing power reverses transport. Rated for 20 RPM and 0.8 tiles per second.
itemDescriptions.Crucible: Holds solid materials such as sand and ore, and can also store hot liquids. A heat source heats only the crucible; its contents melt or transform according to their own temperature and reaction properties.
itemDescriptions.ElectricHeater: Heats the surrounding area while powered and stops when power is lost. Can warm nearby gas tanks.
itemDescriptions.ElectricHeater_Summoner: Heats the surrounding area while powered and stops when power is lost. Can warm nearby gas tanks.
itemDescriptions.Engineering_Goggles: When held or worn over the eyes, reveals hidden wires and lets you interact with them. Can be worn with a helmet.
itemDescriptions.Floor_Bronze_Summoner: A bronze floor laid over ordinary land. It changes only the surface appearance; dismantling it restores the original tile.
itemDescriptions.Floor_Copper_Summoner: A copper floor laid over ordinary land. It changes only the surface appearance; dismantling it restores the original tile.
itemDescriptions.Floor_Iron_Summoner: An iron floor laid over ordinary land. It changes only the surface appearance; dismantling it restores the original tile.
itemDescriptions.Floor_Stone_Summoner: A stone floor laid over ordinary land. It changes only the surface appearance; dismantling it restores the original tile.
itemDescriptions.Floor_Wood_Summoner: A wooden floor laid over ordinary land. It changes only the surface appearance; dismantling it restores the original tile.
itemDescriptions.Flour: Grind five foxtail seeds in a stone mortar to make one portion of flour. It can be eaten directly for carbohydrates and protein, but consumes water.
itemDescriptions.FluidOutlet: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.FluidOutlet_Summoner: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.FluidPipe: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.FluidPipe_Summoner: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.FluidValve: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.FluidValve_Summoner: Connects only the matching gas or liquid network. Pipes store no matter. Valves control flow; outlet rates can be set per second, with 0 stopping output.
itemDescriptions.GasEngine: A hydrogen engine with separate input pipes for hydrogen and oxygen. It consumes them at a 2:1 molar ratio to produce mechanical power and returns water through a liquid output pipe. It stops if hydrogen or oxygen is missing, there is no valid load, or the recovered water tank is full.
itemDescriptions.GasEngine_Summoner: A hydrogen engine with separate input pipes for hydrogen and oxygen. It consumes them at a 2:1 molar ratio to produce mechanical power and returns water through a liquid output pipe. It stops if hydrogen or oxygen is missing, there is no valid load, or the recovered water tank is full.
itemDescriptions.GasSelector: Passes only the selected gas component. Other components remain at the source; substances are never converted.
itemDescriptions.GasSelector_Summoner: Passes only the selected gas component. Other components remain at the source; substances are never converted.
itemDescriptions.Glass: Transparent glass formed by cooling and solidifying molten glass. Used to make glass products.
itemDescriptions.HandDrill: A hand-operated drilling tool that can be placed to open its drilling work panel.
itemDescriptions.HandDrill_Summoner: A portable hand drill. When placed, it shares the hand drill's work state.
itemDescriptions.IronBucket: An iron bucket that can hold water or hot magma. Place it on the ground to catch rain; dismantling it preserves the liquid and rain collection progress.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Diamond_Large: A huge natural diamond deposit with the same mining behavior and drops as a regular diamond deposit. Mine continuously from its edge.
itemDescriptions.Mine_Obsidian: An obsidian deposit beside a mountaintop lava lake. Mine it with a pickaxe to obtain obsidian; there is no minimum tool tier.
itemDescriptions.Obsidian: Sharp black stone scattered along the shore of mountaintop lava lakes. Can be used as a handheld knife or crafted into an obsidian dagger or spear.
itemDescriptions.Ore_Sulfur: Mineral deposits scattered around mountains and mountain lava vents. Can also be obtained by mining sulfur deposits.
itemDescriptions.Plastic: A lightweight plastic made from ethylene at 200 C or above with a polymerization catalyst. Water resistant and easy to shape.
itemDescriptions.Rubber: An elastic, well-insulated material used to make wires.
itemDescriptions.Sand: Place it in a crucible and heat it to the right temperature to melt it into molten glass.
itemDescriptions.ShipFloor_Iron: Four-way connections form an independent hull. A complete floor supports crew and protects them from hazardous tiles below.
itemDescriptions.ShipFloor_Iron_Summoner: Four-way connections form an independent hull. A complete floor supports crew and protects them from hazardous tiles below.
itemDescriptions.ShipFloor_Refractory: Four-way connections form an independent hull. A complete floor supports crew and protects them from hazardous tiles below.
itemDescriptions.ShipFloor_Refractory_Summoner: Four-way connections form an independent hull. A complete floor supports crew and protects them from hazardous tiles below.
itemDescriptions.Shovel_Iron: A durable wrought-iron shovel forged from iron. Suitable for extended digging and harvesting clay.
itemDescriptions.SilkFiber: A long, flexible natural fiber that can be woven into silk.
itemDescriptions.SpaceCultivator: Four separate growing slots can grow different non-tree crops at once. Crops grow when connected to power and real irrigation water; buckets and pipes share the same water tank. Fertilizer is optional, and growth pauses without power or water. Interact to harvest, change seeds, or add water.
itemDescriptions.SpaceCultivator_Summoner: A four-slot planter that can be placed on the ground or a ship floor. It needs power and water. Dismantling it preserves all seeds, crop growth, water, and harvests.
itemDescriptions.Spear_Obsidian: A spear with an obsidian point. Uses the standard spear thrust attack.
itemDescriptions.StoneHammer: A heavy hammer with a stone head and wooden handle. More powerful than a wooden hammer, but each swing costs more stamina.
itemDescriptions.Tree_Dead: A dead tree that can be chopped down for logs and sticks.
itemDescriptions.Tree_Oak: An oak tree that grows in forests and can yield rubber in the same way that resin is collected.
itemDescriptions.WaterElectrolyzer: Electrolyzes water when powered. Fresh water produces a hydrogen-oxygen mix; brine and seawater produce a hydrogen-chlorine mix. It has one water inlet and one gas outlet. Alkali stays in a byproduct chamber that can be emptied with a handheld liquid container; solid impurities are collected in the residue slot.
itemDescriptions.WaterElectrolyzer_Summoner: Electrolyzes water when powered. Fresh water produces a hydrogen-oxygen mix; brine and seawater produce a hydrogen-chlorine mix. It has one water inlet and one gas outlet. Alkali stays in a byproduct chamber that can be emptied with a handheld liquid container; solid impurities are collected in the residue slot.
itemDescriptions.WaterTrough: A placeable wooden trough that holds 64 units of mixed liquid and can be dismantled. It holds no solid items. Each draw removes one liquid in its actual proportion; even less than one unit can be poured or pumped out.
itemDescriptions.Wire_Copper: A copper wire for connecting electrical equipment.
itemDescriptions.Wire_Copper_Summoner: A copper wire for connecting electrical equipment, made from copper and rubber.
itemDescriptions.Beeswax: Golden natural beeswax produced by beehives. It can be eaten directly and is rich in carbohydrates and vitamins, but reduces water by 5.
itemDescriptions.Boat: Crafted from four planks and two logs. Walk into the placed raft to push it. On land or in water, point at it and press F to board. Use the directional keys or stick to row without spending stamina; hold Shift to row faster at the running stamina cost. Point at the raft and press F to dismount, landing on nearby ground when possible or in the water otherwise.
itemDescriptions.BronzePlate: A plate forged from bronze ingots.
itemDescriptions.Cloth: A piece of fabric woven from cotton. Used as a crafting material.
itemDescriptions.CopperPlate: A plate forged from copper ingots.
itemDescriptions.DrilledPlank: A wooden mechanical part made by drilling a through-hole in a plank. Used for the structure and connections of mechanical torque devices.
itemDescriptions.DrilledStick: A wooden mechanical part made by drilling a through-hole in a stick. Used as a shaft core and connector in mechanical torque devices.
itemDescriptions.DrilledStone: A stone mechanical part made by drilling a through-hole in a stone. Used in mechanical torque devices.
itemDescriptions.DrilledStoneSlab: A stone mechanical part made by drilling a through-hole in a slab. Used for the structure and connections of mechanical torque devices.
itemDescriptions.FishingHook_Bone: Attach it to a fishing rod's hook slot and add one food item as bait. It can be cast 10 times. Each successful cast consumes 1 durability; it breaks when durability runs out.
itemDescriptions.FishingHook_Gold: Attach it to a fishing rod's hook slot and add one food item as bait. It can be cast 1,000 times. Each successful cast consumes 1 durability; it breaks when durability runs out.
itemDescriptions.FishingHook_Iron: Attach it to a fishing rod's hook slot and add one food item as bait. It can be cast 100 times. Each successful cast consumes 1 durability; it breaks when durability runs out.
itemDescriptions.FishingRod: Right-click to set a hook and one piece of bait. Left-click to cast; after a small fish takes the bait, left-click again to reel it in.
itemDescriptions.Flower: A few wildflowers gathered from a grass flower layer with scissors. Can be picked up and stacked.
itemDescriptions.GasTankBlock_Iron: Adjacent matching blocks combine into one shared gas tank, adding 100 standard L per block. Natural refill stops at 20% of the total capacity; powered pumps can fill it. Dismantling takes the removed block capacity share of the contents.
itemDescriptions.GasTankBlock_Iron_Summoner: Adjacent matching blocks combine into one shared gas tank, adding 100 standard L per block. Natural refill stops at 20% of the total capacity; powered pumps can fill it. Dismantling takes the removed block capacity share of the contents.
itemDescriptions.GasTankBlock_Steel: Adjacent matching blocks combine into one shared gas tank, adding 100 standard L per block. Natural refill stops at 20% of the total capacity; powered pumps can fill it. Dismantling takes the removed block capacity share of the contents.
itemDescriptions.GasTankBlock_Steel_Summoner: Adjacent matching blocks combine into one shared gas tank, adding 100 standard L per block. Natural refill stops at 20% of the total capacity; powered pumps can fill it. Dismantling takes the removed block capacity share of the contents.
itemDescriptions.Generator_Basic: Connect a wire to the left and a drive shaft to the right. When powered it outputs mechanical power; when mechanically driven it outputs electricity.
itemDescriptions.Generator_Basic_Summoner: Connect a wire to the left and a drive shaft to the right. When powered it outputs mechanical power; when mechanically driven it outputs electricity.
itemDescriptions.GrassBed: A grass bed that occupies two adjacent cells. Sleep in it like a tent.
itemDescriptions.GrassBed_Summoner: A simple bed tied from dry grass and rope. Place it on the ground to sleep.
itemDescriptions.IronPlate: An iron plate forged from wrought iron ingots. Used in further metalworking.
itemDescriptions.MechanicalHammer: Driven by mechanical power, it forges pig iron into wrought iron and hammers wrought iron, copper, bronze, tin, and steel ingots into matching plates.
itemDescriptions.Nail: A metal nail forged from wrought iron ingots. Used to fasten wood and mechanical structures.
itemDescriptions.NaturalMineEntrance: A naturally formed surface cave entrance. Destroying it blocks the corresponding underground exit.
itemDescriptions.OrePowder_Coal: Fine coal powder made by grinding coal ore in a stone mortar. Used for further material processing.
itemDescriptions.OrePowder_Copper: Copper ore powder made by grinding malachite in a stone mortar. Used for further material processing.
itemDescriptions.OrePowder_Gold: Gold ore powder made by grinding gold ore in a stone mortar. Used for further material processing.
itemDescriptions.OrePowder_Iron: Iron ore powder made by grinding iron ore in a stone mortar. Used for further material processing.
itemDescriptions.OrePowder_Niter: Fine niter powder made by grinding niter in a stone mortar. Used to make fertilizer.
itemDescriptions.OrePowder_Stone: Stone powder made by grinding stone in a stone mortar. Used for further material processing.
itemDescriptions.OrePowder_Tin: Tin ore powder made by grinding tin ore in a stone mortar. Used for further material processing.
itemDescriptions.RawIronPlate: A plate hand-forged from pig iron ingots.
itemDescriptions.ShipChemicalEngine: A one-cell airtight block engine that must be installed on the outer edge of a hull. Its nozzle must face outside with a clear path ahead. The nozzle points down and the air inlet points up by default; press R while placing to rotate it. Connect the inlet to hydrogen and oxygen tanks with pipes, and connect a wire.
itemDescriptions.ShipChemicalEngine_Summoner: A one-cell airtight block engine that must be installed on the outer edge of a hull. Its nozzle must face outside with a clear path ahead. The nozzle points down and the air inlet points up by default; press R while placing to rotate it. Connect the inlet to hydrogen and oxygen tanks with pipes, and connect a wire.
itemDescriptions.Shovel_Copper: Right-click three times to dig grass, sand, or peat tiles. Can also dig clay deposits on riverbanks.
itemDescriptions.Shovel_Wood: Right-click six times to dig grass, sand, or peat tiles. Can also dig clay deposits on riverbanks.
itemDescriptions.Silk: A soft, lightweight fabric woven from silk fiber. Used as a crafting material.
itemDescriptions.Spacesuit_Feet: Outer spacesuit armor; choose any clothing to wear underneath. Expands the safe body-temperature range and improves cold and heat resistance. Wearing the full spacesuit—helmet, suit, pants, boots, and gloves—with the helmet on also expands the safe pressure range. Replace the oxygen tank in the suit's configuration panel.
itemDescriptions.Spacesuit_Hands: Outer spacesuit armor; choose any clothing to wear underneath. Expands the safe body-temperature range and improves cold and heat resistance. Wearing the full spacesuit—helmet, suit, pants, boots, and gloves—with the helmet on also expands the safe pressure range. Replace the oxygen tank in the suit's configuration panel.
itemDescriptions.Spacesuit_Head: Outer spacesuit armor; choose any clothing to wear underneath. Expands the safe body-temperature range and improves cold and heat resistance. Wearing the full spacesuit—helmet, suit, pants, boots, and gloves—with the helmet on also expands the safe pressure range. Replace the oxygen tank in the suit's configuration panel.
itemDescriptions.Spacesuit_Legs: Outer spacesuit armor; choose any clothing to wear underneath. Expands the safe body-temperature range and improves cold and heat resistance. Wearing the full spacesuit—helmet, suit, pants, boots, and gloves—with the helmet on also expands the safe pressure range. Replace the oxygen tank in the suit's configuration panel.
itemDescriptions.Spacesuit_Torso: Outer spacesuit armor; choose any clothing to wear underneath. Expands the safe body-temperature range and improves cold and heat resistance. Wearing the full suit with the helmet on also expands the safe pressure range. The configuration panel lets you replace oxygen and propulsion tanks. Landing impacts consume the suit's durability; impacts beyond its protection can still injure the player.
itemDescriptions.Splint: Right-click to choose a body part. After 3 seconds of setting, it immediately restores 10 durability, then restores another 10 after 144 seconds. Splints do not stack on the same body part and do not restore health.
itemDescriptions.SteelNail: A metal nail forged from steel ingots. When used with steel plates to craft a mechanical hammer or sawmill, it increases the finished machine's efficiency by 20%.
itemDescriptions.SteelPlate: A plate forged from steel ingots.
itemDescriptions.StoneThrowingRope: A throwing tool made from rope and leather. Stones in the hotbar and suitable hard ores can be used as sling ammunition. Hold the attack button to charge and show the trajectory, then release to throw. Projectiles can be picked up after landing.
itemDescriptions.TinPlate: A plate forged from tin ingots.
itemDescriptions.Wire_Hidden: Carries power normally. Hold it or wear engineering goggles to see and handle it.
itemDescriptions.WoodenBarrel: A water barrel sealed with planks, rope, and resin. Holds water and six item stacks. Add ten portions of salt to a full barrel of fresh water to make brine. Using resin glue to craft it increases maximum durability by 50%.
itemDescriptions.CrudeOil: Each portion contains 1 L of crude oil feedstock. Heat collected liquid oil to 100 C to extract it; distill four portions at 350 C into two fuel oil, one naphtha and one bitumen.
itemDescriptions.Naphtha: The basic petrochemical feedstock obtained by distillation, 1.5 L per portion. Crack at 750 C into two ethylene and one propylene.
itemDescriptions.Ethylene: Petrochemical feedstock from naphtha cracking. Heat to 200 C with a polymerization catalyst to produce polyethylene (PE), preserving the catalyst.
itemDescriptions.Propylene: A basic petrochemical feedstock obtained by high temperature naphtha cracking, stored for further chemical production.
itemDescriptions.Bitumen: A heavy petroleum fraction, 0.5 L per portion. Makes bitumen floors; at 150 C it can replace resin in adhesive crafting.
itemDescriptions.FuelOil: Liquid fuel from petroleum distillation, 1 L per portion. Place in a crucible at 20 C or above to obtain liquid fuel oil for tanks, pipes and fuel engines.
itemDescriptions.PolymerizationCatalyst: Must reach 200 C together with ethylene. Required for polymerization but never consumed, and can be reused.
itemDescriptions.FuelEngine: Consumes real liquid fuel oil under mechanical load. Connect liquid pipes and a fuel tank to supply it.
itemDescriptions.FuelEngine_Summoner: Consumes real liquid fuel oil under mechanical load. Connect liquid pipes and a fuel tank to supply it.
itemDescriptions.Floor_Bitumen_Summoner: A dark floor made from bitumen, placed as a separate support surface.
itemDescriptions.Wheelbarrow: A hand-built all-wood wheelbarrow. Place it, push from behind, and press F to access its 12-slot cargo inventory.
itemDescriptions.Wheelbarrow_Building: A hand-built all-wood wheelbarrow. Push it from behind and press F to access its 12-slot cargo inventory.
